entries.name: Symbols of Inspiration

description.from: For 1...31 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
description.to: For 6...40 seconds, this skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.

concise.from: (1...31 seconds.) This skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
concise.to: (6...40 seconds.) This skill becomes the Elite of target foe. Elite skills you cast use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.

notes: [base] Reduce recharge from 15 to 10 and increase duration from 1..31 to 6..40. (This change was in the original update notes, but the game data wasn't properly updated.)
override: recharge 15 -> 10, duration 1...31 -> 6...40 (did not land Aug 26)

entries.name: Mirage Cloak

description.from: For 20 seconds, you have a 40% chance to block and an additional 10% for each enchantment (max 80%). Each time an enchantment is removed from you, all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage.
description.to: For 20 seconds, you have a 40% chance to block and an extra 4...10% for each additional enchantment (max 80%). All nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage each time a Dervish enchantment is removed from you.

concise.from: (20 seconds.) You have 40% chance to block and an additional 10% for each enchantment (max 80%). Deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes each time an enchantment is removed from you.
concise.to: (20 seconds.) 40% chance to block and an extra 4...10% for each additional enchantment. 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes when you lose a Dervish enchantment.

notes: [base] Adjust additional block chance to 4..10 (so that Earth investment is required) and fixed a bug where damage from enchantment removal was getting improperly multiplied.
override: extra block per enchantment 10% -> 4...10%, only Dervish enchantments trigger damage (wiki text)
